title: The Map Folded to the Park
youtube_title: The Map Folded to the Park | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A smaller piece, fairly given, can still be enough.
summary: At a bakery counter on a soft, busy morning, Sora sees that a map folded open to the park will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Sora makes a smaller, even share so Lumen is included, and Ms. Okonkwo lets the choice stand without a speech.
